metadata.title: Project ROI and cash flow, 1974–1982
metadata.scope: Five-entity project ecosystem, pre-tax and unlevered; not shareholder ROI or consolidated legal accounts
metadata.scenario: Full-demand central industrial plan; historical constrained-delivery forecasts retained as reference only
metadata.accounting_status: Planning cash-cost and depreciation bridge, not audited GAAP financial statements

definitions.quarterly_pretax_roi: Quarter EBIT / average opening and closing operating assets (net modeled fixed assets including CIP + inventory). Nonannualized pre-tax ROIC proxy; no tax assumption.
definitions.cumulative_accounting_roi: Cumulative EBIT / (cumulative capex + ending inventory). Custom since-inception accounting ROI, not annualized; do not compare directly with quarterly ROI.
definitions.cumulative_cash_return: Cumulative free cash flow / peak external funding requirement to date. Includes pre-revenue losses; excludes terminal asset-sale value. During maximum funding draw the ratio can be -100%.
definitions.free_cash_flow: Net revenue − cash operating costs − capex − change in inventory. Depreciation is deducted only for EBIT, not cash flow.
definitions.net_revenue: Customer spend less channel fees and expected promotional credits; BPI independent sales and Academy direct tuition included once.
definitions.operating_assets: Net fixed assets plus gross inventory. No AR, AP, debt, excess cash or legal-entity tax balance sheet is supplied.
definitions.peak_external_funding: Maximum cumulative negative free cash balance, starting at zero. Existing founder-equity commitments finance this requirement; they are not operating returns.

assumptions.matching: Current 1980–82 reaction demand matches industrial production and revenue exactly. Earlier basket realization is retained; later prices use dated June snapshots. June snapshots proxy the whole June month. No historical 1982 competitor quote is asserted.
assumptions.academy: Industrial-plan course volumes and staffing retained. Requested-course mix used where available; otherwise stated mix. Direct tuition charged once. Permanent teaching payroll already funded.
assumptions.sales_end_1980: November 19–December sales and quantities use the industrial extrapolation at the final forecast price. No invented Abacus 3/Pulse 3 incremental software sales.
assumptions.working_capital: One-quarter-ahead inventory funding through 1982; terminal inventory retained without liquidation. Cash collection and no supplier credit remain planning assumptions.
assumptions.depreciation: Straight-line zero-salvage planning lives: buildings 20y, fab tools 10y, fitout 7y, other equipment 5y; quarter after service. Explicit fab commissioning dates prevent depreciation of construction in progress.
assumptions.marketing: Replace existing generic campaign/dealer expense in the ROI bridge; underlying historical industrial file remains an independently reproducible baseline. Credits are contra-revenue, other marketing is expense.
assumptions.ownership: No company-specific ROI is asserted: Logix/AION basket revenue sharing, semiconductor transfer prices and several licences remain unspecified. Costs/marketing retain entity attribution; internal DRI royalties/reimbursements are eliminated in ecosystem totals.
exclusions: Income/payroll taxes beyond existing loaded wages, interest/debt schedules, shareholder distributions, new acquisition/equity valuations
Receivables/payables collection effects, VAT/sales tax and Danish FX
Unforecast OEM sales, unsupported product revenues and terminal asset value
Unknown acquisition/replacement cost of future equipment in the secret facility
assumptions.1981_extension: Reassessed demand through December 1982 from market_outlook.py. Dated balanced prices, 1982 process investment and Team costs included. Initial Team price uses first available 1982 snapshot; no volume savings from the unproven 2 um ramp.
assumptions.bounds: Marketing sensitivity is 0.65×/1×/1.75× planned spending only. It does not cover all sales, BOM or fab-yield uncertainty.

historical_context.title: Apple marketing plan (archival primary document)
historical_context.use: Supports period mix of press, dealer co-op, demonstrations, PR and direct mail; proposed dealer co-op was 5% of sales. Model uses 2% of net basket receipts as its own assumption, not a quoted Logix rate.

historical_context.title: Issuer ROIC reconciliation filed with SEC
historical_context.use: Illustrates explicit numerator/denominator reconciliation and that ROIC definitions differ. This project uses a clearly labelled pre-tax operating-assets proxy, not that issuer’s after-tax measure.

memory_manufacturing.era_policy: ERA1 and its 6/8 MHz variants remain 55 mm2 on the original 3.0 um Micralign process. No CPU shrink or speed-bin uplift.

development_line.basis: Separate pilot bay; 25 passes/hour, eight layers, 65% OEE. No added saleable output or legacy capacity credit.

future_capital_schedule.purpose: 1.5 um selected release and matching; commissioned 1983-Q4

memory_manufacturing.boundary: Future budgets after 1982 excluded from closed-horizon cash/ROI; reported as forward commitments. Recurring RAM repair costs are inside chip costs, not charged again as pilot operations.

engineering_1982.basis: Half of paid retained Labs engineering payroll is allocated first; remainder is incremental. Pilot nonpayroll is separate. June 1982 mature 3 um RAM unit costs retained for volume; 2 um output not credited before repeatability.
